options.content: **Traffic and load across the grid.** Requests enter at the front door (__FRONT_DOOR_LABEL__), the hub gateway picks a backend by measured availability, and each site's operator relays what its EPP sees. Arrow width is the backend's share of routed traffic, color is its saturation against the learned ceiling. Gray means the hub has no measurement for that backend.

panels.title: Where traffic goes, and how loaded each backend is
panels.description: Arrow width is each backend's share of routed requests over the last minute; arrow and box color is its saturation (rho, in-flight over the learned ceiling): green has room, amber is near the ceiling, red is at it. Gray means unmeasured. All inputs are relayed from each site's EPP by its operator; the gateway counts nothing of its own.
